payload.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-07-13
payload.summary:
**OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol drama spilled into public view**; usage caps, context-window rollbacks, and subscription promises turned product tuning into weekend discourse; builders kept pushing anyway, from "meeting transcript as PRD" to chess fine-tuning and multi-machine agent setups; the bigger argument underneath it all was ownership, with **Vercel**, **Box**, and others pressing for open control over models, data, and workflow IP.

**这波最热还是 GPT-5.6 Sol**；限额、上下文回调、套餐归属全被摊到台面上讲，产品运营像直播拆机；另一边，开发者没停，拿会议纪要直接做 PRD、在 **Replit** 上微调下棋模型、把一堆机器串起来跑 agent，路子一个比一个野；更底层的话题也很直接，**Vercel**、**Box** 这些人都在盯同一件事：模型会换，真正该攥在手里的还是数据、评测和工作流。

sections.headline: **No Priors** tours **Valar Atomics** on nuclear power for the AI age · **No Priors** 探访 **Valar Atomics**，聊 AI 时代的核能供电
sections.body:
**No Priors** visits **Valar Atomics** founder **Isaiah Taylor** at the company's Utah facility and frames nuclear as an answer to AI's growing power appetite. Taylor argues the industry stalled after Three Mile Island, then got trapped in simulation-heavy "paper reactor" culture while the real bottleneck shifted to hardware iteration and manufacturing.

He says **Valar** is trying to restart the cycle with small, manufactured reactors, empirical testing, and the Department of Energy pathway instead of waiting for fully mature commercial licensing. The pitch is blunt: cheaper energy creates its own demand, and AI compute is only making that pressure harder to ignore.

**No Priors** 跑到 **Valar Atomics** 在犹他州的场地，和创始人 **Isaiah Taylor** 正面聊核能，核心问题很直接：AI 吃电越来越凶，新的供给从哪来。Taylor 的说法是，三里岛之后美国核电一脚刹停，后来整个行业又越来越像“纸面反应堆”行业，模型和仿真很多，真机迭代太少。

他觉得 **Valar** 要补的就是这一下：先把小型、可制造、能实测的反应堆跑起来，走能源部测试通道，不是死等完整商业牌照。逻辑也不绕，电只要更便宜，需求自己会冒出来，而 AI 正在把这个问题越抬越高。

sections.headline: **OpenAI** details **GPT-5.6 Sol** usage fixes for paid users · **OpenAI** 公开说明 **GPT-5.6 Sol** 付费用户用量修正
sections.body:
Updates for Codex and ChatGPT Work users. No nerfing, only good stuff!

- We have landed inference optimizations and are passing down savings to all the subscriptions for GPT-5.6 Sol. That should result in around 10% more usage on its own.
- We noticed that by changing the context size limit in the product to 372k for GPT-5.6 Sol, up from 272k for GPT-5.5, it resulted in more usage being charged than intended. We have reverted to 272k and will work to roll back out to 372k in the days to come. You should notice that usage drains significantly less after this change.
- To understand where the extra usage was coming from, we ran some experiments where reasoning efforts were changed (referred to as juice values under the hood) and have reverted this.
- There is slightly more usage of multi-agent than intended in high and xhigh reasoning effort, we are fixing this going forward. Also fixing a small other thing we noticed with auto-review where we can be more efficient.

And we continue to have the 5h limit temporarily not apply. Enjoy the rest of the weekend!

给 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 用户的更新。不是削弱，都是往好的调！

- 我们已经上线推理优化，并把节省下来的成本回给所有 **GPT-5.6 Sol** 订阅。单这一项，使用量大概就能多出 10%。
- 我们发现把产品里的上下文上限从 **GPT-5.5** 的 272k 调到 **GPT-5.6 Sol** 的 372k 后，实际扣掉的用量比预期高。现在已经先退回 272k，接下来几天会再把 372k 推回来。你应该会明显感觉这次调整后，额度掉得慢了不少。
- 为了查清额外消耗从哪来，我们做过一些实验，改过 reasoning effort，也就是内部说的 juice 值，现在已经撤回。
- high 和 xhigh reasoning effort 下，多 agent 的消耗略高于预期，我们后面会修。auto-review 那边也发现一个小点，还能再省一点。

另外，5 小时限制暂时还是不生效。周末继续用。

sections.headline: **Aaron Levie** says the real enterprise prize is workflow IP, not raw model access · **Aaron Levie** 说企业真正值钱的是工作流 IP，不是单拿到模型
sections.body:
One of the key architectural questions of the 21st century in business will be how you maximize your corporate IP in the form of decisions, insights, workflow patterns, and best practices in a world where so much intelligence is packed into AI models.

One might think these questions could just get bitter lessoned out of existence, but in reality they become even more germane as intelligence becomes more powerful. In a world where any firm also has access to frontier intelligence, understanding how you leverage it uniquely becomes a critical question.

That’s why so much value is left to be created between the enterprise and the underlying AI itself. Having evals for your workflows, ensuring that you can route models from different tiers of intelligence, capturing traces in a way that improve your own workflows, and making sure the value of your information compounds as AI gets better all become critical considerations.

Which is also why there’s so much opportunity right now in the applied AI layer. The companies that help figure this out for other enterprises will be in the best position to win the next enterprise workloads.

21 世纪企业架构里一个关键问题会是：在越来越多智能被塞进 AI 模型之后，企业怎么把自己的 IP 发挥到最大，包括决策、洞察、工作流模式和最佳实践这些东西。

有人可能会觉得，这些问题最后都会被 bitter lesson 一把抹平，但实际恰好相反，智能越强，这些问题越躲不开。当前沿智能谁都能拿到时，真正关键的是你怎么把它用出自己的路数。

所以企业和底层 AI 之间，还有大量价值没被做出来。给工作流做 eval、在不同智能层级之间路由模型、记录 traces 来反哺自己的流程、确保你的信息随着 AI 变强而持续复利，这些都很要命。

这也是为什么应用层 AI 现在机会还很多。谁能帮企业把这套东西理顺，谁就更可能拿下下一批企业工作负载。

sections.headline: Tokenmaxxing without a real customer still goes nowhere · token 拉满但讲不清用户是谁，还是白搭
sections.body:
What’s funny is I’ll meet so many people in SF who’ll claim they are tokenmaxxing and have all of these subagents looping things for them..

But when I ask them “what” and for “whom” are they building, very few can give me a straight answer. 

Shows that even in this insane AI era, simplicity and direction are still ridiculously important. 

So before you let your tokens go brrr, take some time to think if what you’re building (for a living) is actually important. 

Time is literally the only thing you don’t get back!

好笑的是，我在旧金山会遇到很多人，说自己在疯狂 tokenmaxxing，手上挂着一堆 subagent 在那循环干活。

但我一问他们到底在做什么、又是给谁做，真正能把话说明白的人很少。

这说明就算在现在这个离谱的 AI 时代，简单和方向感还是重要得夸张。

所以在你让 token 开始狂飙之前，先想想你拿来谋生的这件东西，到底是不是真的重要。

时间真的是唯一拿不回来的东西。

sections.headline: **Claude** explains how **Fable 5** fits into weekly limits · **Claude** 说明 **Fable 5** 和每周额度怎么一起算
sections.body:
As before, you can use up to half of your weekly usage limit on Fable 5. After that, you can continue using Fable 5 with usage credits, or switch to another model to keep working within your remaining limits.

More details here: https://t.co/5inr3k2VM5

和之前一样，你每周额度里最多有一半可以用在 **Fable 5** 上。到这个上限后，你可以继续用 usage credits 跑 **Fable 5**，或者切到其他模型，在剩余额度内继续工作。

更多细节在这里： https://t.co/5inr3k2VM5

sections.headline: **Anthropic** extends **Claude Fable 5** access through July 19 · **Anthropic** 把 **Claude Fable 5** 的开放期延到 7 月 19 日
sections.body:
We're extending Claude Fable 5 access on all paid plans, as well as keeping Claude Code’s weekly rate limits 50% higher, through July 19.

我们把 **Claude Fable 5** 在所有付费套餐上的开放期延长到 7 月 19 日，同时让 **Claude Code** 的每周限额继续保持高出 50%。
